contexts.text: Borne from the belly, and carried from the womb (). ( = from the beginning of the Church. AC 5550.) ( = those being regenerated, and those who have been regenerated. AE 710:3.)
Give them a miscarrying womb () = the perversion of good and truth. ( = that they have... falsities from evil in place of truth from good... Womb = truths from the good of love. AE 710:5.)
